name: civic-air-quality-briefing-studio
description: Production-grade, zero-dependency civic air quality intelligence studio powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash

scripts.start: node -e "import('http').then(h => { const fs = import('fs'); const s = h.createServer((req, res) => { let p = req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.slice(1); if (fs.existsSync(p)) { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': p.endsWith('.js') ? 'application/javascript' : p.endsWith('.css') ? 'text/css' : 'text/html'}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }); s.listen(3000, () => console.log('Serving on http://localhost:3000')); })"
